thread:
maria_marketing: Hey runtime folks — quick ask. We have a launch post scheduled in ~72h, and marketing needs a short metrics pulse + minimal repro artifacts for the claims. Can the runtime team run a small reproduce+smoke set for the quantized model variants and confirm coldstart warmup behavior? :pray:

maria_marketing: Need a concrete checklist we can attach to the PR: p50/p95 token latencies, coldstart heatmap, sample inputs, raw token counts, and any outlier traces. Also need the exact model tags we should call out in the blog (e.g. redwood-v2-q4_0).

maria_marketing: Timeline: ideally results by EOD tomorrow (so marketing can finalize screenshots). Is that feasible?


dina_runtime: @maria_marketing ok — we can do a focused sweep. Quick clarifying q's: which model family (v1/v2), target region (us-west/us-east/eu), and do you want quantized GPU runs only or CPU fallback runs too?

maria_marketing: v2 family (the ones in the model catalog), primary region us-west, include quantized GPU runs + CPU fallback for the warmup coldstart comparison. Please include the variant names we should display.

kai_eng: I can spare a node for overnight runs. Suggest sample size = 200 queries spread across short/medium/long contexts. Also recommend capturing 99th percentile request traces for anomalies.

sam_dataops: For reproducibility we'll need the seed, request payloads, and the exact docker/runtime image tag. Dina, can you also export the KV cache warmup logs? Those make the warmup differences obvious.

maria_marketing: Perfect — the marketing checklist needs: short summary paragraph, 2 tables (latency percentiles + token cost), one heatmap image (coldstart vs steady), and zipped artifact: inputs.jsonl, traces.tar.gz, run_metadata.json. We will host screenshots from that zip.


dina_runtime: Got it. I'll run the sweep with these artifacts. Plan:
- run: 3 variants (fp16, q4_0, q8_0)
- sample: 200 samples (stratified)
- metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens-per-second, tokens-per-request, memory usage
- artifacts: inputs.jsonl, run_metadata.json (image tag, hw, region, seed), traces.tar.gz (top-10 outlier requests)

dina_runtime: Triggering a CI job now. Command (internal):
```
./scripts/run_bench --model redwood-v2 --variants fp16,q4_0,q8_0 --samples 200 --region us-west --out artifacts/1822003333/
```

runtime-bot: CI job 48291 queued by dina_runtime — status: running. :gear:

kai_eng: I'll monitor the GPU node and grab the heatmap render. If we see any >2.5x coldstart regressions we'll annotate with probable causes (quantization, kernel fallback).

maria_marketing: Thanks — can we get a one-paragraph embargoable summary (2-3 sentences) when you have preliminary numbers? We'll use that in the launch PR. :eyes:

sam_dataops: Also adding a quick annotation request: tag any samples where output quality deviates (BLEU/ROUGE or semantic-similarity thresholds) so marketing doesn't accidentally highlight degraded outputs.


dina_runtime: Will do. ETA for CI finish ~3 hours, artifact bundle posted when done. I'll ping the thread with artifacts link.

runtime-bot: CI job 48291 completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-inference-bench/1822003333/ (logs + artifacts.zip).

kai_eng: Quick glance — fp16 vs q4_0 p95 difference ~12%, coldstart for q8_0 spiked but steady-state similar. I'll toss over heatmap + callouts in the artifacts folder.

maria_marketing: Amazing — thank you all. We'll draft the marketing copy from the embargo summary and attach the artifact bundle. If anything changes we can cut an update. :thumbsup:
